items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I think I was playing there once and got acquainted with him... I said I would like to have this arrangement and he said I'll bring you one... he did become a very nice arranger.

ctx.x: I think I was playing there once and got acquainted with him, he had an act or something and I did a number and I kind of liked it, and at that time I spoke to him and told him I liked it. He said do you want it? I said I would like to have this arrangement and he said I'll bring you one. I said what do I owe you; just tell them where you got him, let me do some arranging and he did become a very nice arranger.
Well you know, Marv was the music director for a time for the Lucy Show.
Yeah. And another well known musician, a brass man, a trombone man and writer, J.J. Johnson. He finally got straightened.
